summary.text: Jimmy Dixon is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 4 since 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A turkey farmer by profession, he advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jimmy Dixon, listed by Ballotpedia as James Dixon, earned a B.S. from Wake Forest University in 1969 and worked as a turkey farmer.
He assumed office in the state House in 2011.

In the 2023-2024 session, Dixon was senior chair of the Agriculture Committee and of the Appropriations on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources Committee, and vice chair of the Appropriations Committee.
